BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Fain, King, Hill, Rivers, and Benton
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring the removal of graffiti from state-owned transportation facilities by the department of transportation within twenty-four hours of notice.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the removal of graffiti from state-owned transportation facilities; and adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The department must remove graffiti from all stateowned transportation facilities within twenty-four hours of the graffiti being reported to the department.
